source.quote: U.S. Federal $ 7,435 $ 7,630 $ 2,751 U.S. State 2,070 2,450 2,125 International 1,674 2,228 3,419 Total cash taxes paid, net of refunds $ 11,179 $ 12,308 $ 8,295 [USD millions; FY2025 is the 3rd figure in the row]

notes: Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet, net of refunds, from the income-tax note's table of cash taxes paid (U.S. federal 2,751, U.S. state 2,125, international 3,419; total 8,295 million); the supplemental cash-flow lines show the same 8,295. The 10-K says the 2025 Tax Act (accelerated depreciation, immediate expensing of domestic R&D) significantly decreased cash taxes in 2025. R&D not reported as a separate line. Amazon reports 'Technology and infrastructure' expense (108,521 million in 2025), which the 10-K says includes payroll for employees involved in research and development alongside store maintenance, AWS infrastructure and other costs; the filing does not call the line R&D, so it is not recorded.
